svg.title: Row-wise sparse input distribution
svg.desc: Fixed stride, unweighted KJT: bucketization, split-metadata uploads, host reads, and payload exchanges. Solid bars: logical execution/access scopes; hollow dashed bars: unconsumed requests. Blue H2D, red D2H/host sync, purple AllToAll, amber request wait, green stream dependency. _input_dists[row_wise](features) dispatch under KJT_SPLITS_DIST; optional local dedup has already run block_bucketize_sparse_features owner = id // block; local_id = id % block; equal contiguous shards in this example KJTAllToAll(bucketized KJT) activities [46-54] compute tensor splits dist_splits → length_per_key → _safe_tolist If uncached and nonempty CUDA lengths: sum → D2H → current_stream.synchronize() → Python list torch.tensor(..., device=cuda) × 3 H1-a: lengths splits, self._input_splits[0] → int64[P], 8P bytes. H1-b: values splits, self._input_splits[1] → int64[P], 8P bytes. H1-c: stride, [input.stride()] * P → int64[P], 8P bytes. construct split metadata activities [55-58] stack/stage per-peer counts; torch.stack(...).flatten() AllToAll #1: splits activity [59] ncclDevKernel_SendRecv First wait: consume the split-size request KJTAllToAllSplitsAwaitable delegates to SplitsAllToAllAwaitable.wait(). splits Work.wait() Establish readiness for the following metadata read; host readback is a separate step below. _safe_tolist_2d(received CUDA splits) D2H + current_stream.synchronize(): CPU needs receive sizes before allocating payload buffers. batch: read sent splits for overflow validation The pinned _wait_impl also calls _safe_tolist_2d(input_tensor): another D2H / stream sync, before payload launch. wait() -> allocate receive tensors Sample [60-61] D2H/H2D metadata is expanded above and below; allocate from known receive sizes. _get_recat: Python permutation → CUDA tensor Fixed/equal stride: torch.tensor(recat, device=cuda, dtype=int32); uneven batches use extra offset tensors. AllToAll #2: KJT lengths Example execution [62]; one all_to_all_single for the lengths tensor. AllToAll #3: KJT ID values Example execution [63]; a separate all_to_all_single for ID values; optional fields add calls. Second wait: consume payload Work handles Lengths and values must be usable before recat / local KJT reconstruction. KeyedJaggedTensor.dist_init(recat) activities [64-72] restore feature-major KJT dist_init(...).sync() → length_per_key Fixed-stride path, uncached nonempty CUDA lengths: D2H + stream synchronization to rebuild host metadata. received local-shard KJT input_dist outer wait().wait() completes

g.title: D2H / HOST SYNC · CPU needs CUDA values

g.text: Fixed-stride path, uncached nonempty CUDA lengths: D2H + stream synchronization to rebuild host metadata.

svg.text: The conditional pre-bucket read 01 belongs to Index calculation (Fig. 2); this sequence starts with the row-wise distributor.
H1 is one diagram message containing three H2D copies, H1-a / H1-b / H1-c; each copies 8P bytes and has its own inventory row.
P is the number of ranks (>1); F is the input feature count before bucketization. Initial buffers and batch KJT uploads are excluded.
D1 / D2 / D3 mark distinct host-read sites, not a fixed count of runtime stalls; cached / empty paths may skip work.
The three input collectives are distinct: one fixed-size metadata exchange, then lengths and values payload exchanges.
unbucketize_permute is retained in SequenceShardingContext for the output-side restore.
Activity IDs, sizes, kernel names and optimizer details illustrate one execution configuration; they are not fixed for every run.
V2 marks the pinned-version input-splits validation readback; D1-D3 are not an exhaustive synchronization count.
TorchRec 1d87b8f79b7b / Logical scopes, not measured durations. Request wait consumes a handle; stream dependencies order GPU work.
